Name: PokeValley Cards - TCG Pokemon
Author: Jolamods
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54561/54561-1792947780-1188085961.gif[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54561/54561-1792951860-1535154838.gif[/img]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54561/54561-1792917260-1351768800.png[/img][/center]

A new collection has arrived in the valley! Buy boosters around town, enjoy opening them one card at a time, and fill your own Pokémon binder.

[b]A collecting and trading mod — not a playable TCG battle system.[/b]


[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54561/54561-1792917261-1170525646.png[/img][/center]

[list]
[*]1,084 cards across five expansions, with official card and booster artwork.[/*]
[*]Animated openings with sound, new-discovery cues and a recap of your pulls and their total value.[/*]
[*]A blue Pokédex-style binder with page gestures, filters, favourites, card inspection, flip and zoom.[/*]
[*]Meet Theo inside Pierre’s shop: sell cards or browse three daily singles. Protect favourites in your binder before selling.[/*]
[*]Exchange cards with another player in co-op. Both players must confirm; protected favourites cannot be offered.[/*]
[*]Mouse, keyboard and controller support. Optional Generic Mod Config Menu settings.[/*]
[/list]
Most packs return less gold than they cost, while rare finds can be valuable. Values and odds are balanced for the mod; they do not represent real-world prices or official pull rates.


[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54561/54561-1792917261-1185336505.png[/img][/center]

[list]
[*][b]151:[/b] Pierre’s shop.[/*]
[*][b]Destined Rivals:[/b] Adventurer’s Guild.[/*]
[*][b]Prismatic Evolutions:[/b] Sandy’s Oasis.[/*]
[*][b]Ascended Heroes:[/b] Krobus in the Sewers.[/*]
[*][b]30th Celebration:[/b] Qi’s Casino, paid with Qi Coins.[/*]
[*][b]Traveling Cart:[/b] a rotating selection of 1–3 expansions when the cart visits.[/*]
[/list]
Fixed shops stock 10 boosters per day. The cart normally carries 2–8 packs per selected expansion. Shop access follows normal game progression.


[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54561/54561-1792917260-2092438612.png[/img][/center]

[b]Complete an expansion[/b] to unlock its exclusive display. Claim it in your binder, place it indoors or outdoors, and choose a card to exhibit without consuming a copy. Each expansion has its own design.

[b]Discover 500 different cards[/b] to learn the Booster Vending Machine recipe. Craft it with 20 Iridium Bars, 10 Battery Packs, 25 Refined Quartz and 100 Hardwood. It sells five packs of each expansion per day at a 10% markup. All machines share the same stock. Limits and prices can be adjusted in GMCM.


[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54561/54561-1792917262-1845142823.png[/img][/center]

[list]
[*]Read your welcome letter when you first load the mod.[/*]
[*]Press [b]K[/b] or [b]controller Y[/b] to open the binder with default settings.[/*]
[*]Hold a booster and [b]right-click / A[/b]. Drag across its seal or use the open button.[/*]
[*]Inspect cards to flip and zoom. Drag or use the wheel to turn binder pages.[/*]
[*]Visit Theo to sell cards or buy singles. [b]Sell all includes your last copy[/b] and asks for confirmation.[/*]
[*]For co-op exchanges, open [b]K → Trade[/b]. Both players and the host need this mod version; only one language edition per player.[/*]
[/list]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54561/54561-1792917261-459390709.png[/img][/center]

[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] for Stardew Valley 1.6.[/*]
[*]Download this complete language edition and extract [b]PelicanCards[/b] into your game’s [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Optional: install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b].[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Install only ONE PokeValley language edition at a time.[/b] No other PokeValley edition, Content Patcher or separate card download is required. Match the game language to the edition for native dialogue and item text. Back up your save before adding or updating mods.

[b]Co-op note:[/b] the exchange protocol and controller flow have been checked in internal tests; a two-computer live session has not yet been verified.

[b]Credits[/b]
Mod: JolaMods. Stardew Valley: ConcernedApe. Pokémon card and booster artwork belongs to its respective owners: The Pokémon Company, Nintendo, GAME FREAK and Creatures. This is an unofficial fan mod.
